root_cause: The prior speak-after-tool tightening HELD: in the passing run (b9e79792) and in the closest-failing run (704e3554) the agent speaks past-tense '...is now on test...' AFTER put_account_on_test returns, with NO in-progress 'I'm placing the branch on test' phrasing. The 2/3 turn-splitting failure mode from run 7c0d0643 did NOT recur. This run's 2 failures are TWO DIFFERENT, NEW, stochastic audio-channel failure modes, neither caused by the SMS-decline instruction logic: (1) run 704e3554 is a minor TEXT_MISMATCH where the semantic scorer (score 2, 'Minor Omissions') penalized the agent for dropping the word 'Dallas' (and 'verified') from the on-test confirmation; all three named goal expectations PASSED and send_confirmation_sms was correctly NOT invoked. (2) run 670883f5 is an ASR/turn-alignment breakdown unrelated to SMS: turn 2 the agent's output was the user's own utterance echoed back, turn 3 produced an empty response, and turn 4 produced a spurious 'that passcode did not match' (the spoken 'Bluebird' failed to align), which cascaded the rest of the conversation off-script. The eval is at an intermediate pass rate (1/3) with non-shared, transcription-driven failure modes -> flaky audio behavior, not a deterministic agent bug.

decision_tree_path: Did turn-splitting (speak-before-tool) persist? -> NO: both failing runs and the passing run use correct past-tense '...is now on test...' after the tool returns; the fix held.
Is the golden expectation stale? -> NO: agent behavior in 704e3554 is correct in substance (named goals all PASS); only the semantic paraphrase scorer dimmed it.
Is a tool missing? -> NO: all required tools present and invoked correctly; send_confirmation_sms correctly NOT called.
Is the behavior inherently non-deterministic (1/3, two different audio failure modes)? -> YES: TEXT_MISMATCH paraphrase miss in one run, ASR/turn-alignment breakdown in the other. Stop here: flaky.
fix_summary_one_line: Not a regression of turn-splitting (fix held). Treat as flaky audio: run more iterations to confirm, or convert this golden to a simulation; optionally relax turn-4 confirmation wording so the semantic scorer does not penalize dropping 'Dallas'/'verified'.
notes: Two distinct NON-shared causes in this singleton eval: (A) 704e3554 = borderline TEXT_MISMATCH (semantic score 2, dropped 'Dallas'); (B) 670883f5 = audio ASR/turn-alignment breakdown (user utterance echoed as agent output, empty turn, spurious passcode-mismatch cascade) -- not SMS-logic related. If the main thread wants a deterministic-side mitigation for (A) only, the lightest agent-side nudge is to make Put_On_Test step 2 explicitly require naming the branch ('reference the branch by name AND its account last digits'), but the dominant driver is audio flakiness, so flaky/sim-conversion is the primary recommendation.
